description: This Java class defines a QuickTextKey used in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It extends AddOnImpl and manages properties related to quick text keys, including popup keyboard resources, labels, icons, and output text.

classes.name: QuickTextKey
classes.description: Represents a quick text key with properties for popup keyboard, labels, icons, and output text, extending AddOnImpl.

methods.name: QuickTextKey
methods.description: Constructor initializing the QuickTextKey with various resource IDs, labels, icons, and other properties.

methods.name: getStringArrayFromValuesResId
methods.description: Returns a string array from resources given a resource ID for values.

methods.name: getStringArrayFromNamesResId
methods.description: Returns a string array from resources given a resource ID for names.

methods.name: isPopupKeyboardUsed
methods.description: Checks if a popup keyboard resource ID is set.

methods.name: getPopupKeyboardResId
methods.description: Returns the resource ID of the popup keyboard.

methods.name: getPopupListNames
methods.description: Returns the list of popup list names.

methods.name: getPopupListValues
methods.description: Returns the list of popup list values.

methods.name: getKeyOutputText
methods.description: Returns the output text associated with the key.

methods.name: getKeyLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the key, nullable.
